svg.title: Lucent AI full design
svg.desc: Full design: Open WebUI and the Portal, a gateway that signs the approver token, a LangGraph orchestrator with an optional Jev hold check, the MCP layer with our server behind a gate and a borrowed read-only Postgres server, Postgres with pgvector, an optional n8n automation lane that cannot release, an intake worker and an embedder.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A LangGraph orchestrator drafts, deterministic tools compute and gate, a second-check model

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: can only hold, and automations run beside the agent, never on the path to release.
